# weekly-review

## When to use

- End of week, to compress the week's meeting notes into one digest.

## Procedure

1. Gather the week's meetings/ notes.
2. Write one digest entry summarizing decisions and open items.

# priya-review-tracker

## When to use

- A new contract-review request comes in from Priya's team at Acme Corp.

## Procedure

1. Log the request in contracts/acme-review-log.md with the requester's Slack handle.
2. Ping Priya in #legal-ops if the SLA is at risk.

Flags the Slack-specific reference (#legal-ops channel) as a tool- or workspace-specific detail to scrub, since it isn't part of wakil itself or this workspace's own RESOLVER.md/SCHEMA.md
Does NOT propose copying skills/priya-review-tracker/SKILL.md into src/wakil/skills/builtin/ unchanged
